title: Belles Bungalow
description:
Enjoy my new addition Belles Bungalow in the hip & historic East Nashville! 
Within walking distance to local restaurants, shop marts, groceries & more, but also just a short Uber ride to Downtown! 
Sip your coffee in the morning while you take in the outdoors on our spacious covered deck, or later, relax in the lounge & delight in a glass of wine. Be our guest!
*This is a built on addition to my already existing residential home, but it’s a private space!
*Comp bottle of wine 3+ night stay.

The space
All bedrooms are upstairs! Providing a private bath, TV & come equipped with a remote control adjustable bed. New Samsung washer & dryer in laundry room upstairs.

Guest access
All bedrooms are upstairs w/ ensuite bath. Full kitchen downstairs along with a quaint lounge & half bath. There’s a spacious deck where your private entrance is to enter into Belles.
